items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: but the dancer was named Flo.

ctx.x: And that was -- there was a Mr. Jerry Sullivan. He was supposed to be the manager. I don't know what Mr. Jerry was, but he was -- anyhow he was nice to us. They were all nice to us. And there's -- I'm trying -- Flo -- it wasn't Freddy and Flo, but the dancer was named Flo. And who else worked there that you'd like to know about? I don't know. Anyhow, I know Duke's band -- I mean Elmer Snowden's band was there.
Elmer told me that one night the boss came to him and said, look, when you leave tonight, tell the boys to take their instruments. And they didn't.
